title: Lockheed, TTSA and killing the Schumer bill

tellings.quote: Maybe that also explains Robert Weiss, the director of Skunk Works, and his connection to Tom DeLonge and TTSA, To The Stars Academy, later in 2017.

plain: Michels suggests that Lockheed, the aerospace company, may be tied both to the UFO company To The Stars Academy (TTSA), which the musician Tom DeLonge set up in 2017, and to the defeat of the Schumer bill, a proposed law in Congress on government UFO records. He points to Robert Weiss, the director of Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft-building division, and his connection to DeLonge and TTSA in 2017, and he also names a congressman named Mike Turner. Michels offers this as his own theory, in an episode about a scientist named Townsend Brown. If he is right, a defence contractor would have helped shape both the public UFO story and the law meant to open it up.
